# Durham Heating & Cooling

> Durham Heating & Cooling is an Ontario heating and cooling contractor based in Durham. Homeowners call the team for furnace and air conditioner repair, heat pump and ductless installation, fireplace service, smart thermostat setup, and full-system duct cleaning across Grey County.

Phone: (519) 369-5147  |  Email: contact@durhamontarioheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://durhamontarioheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Durham, Hanover, Walkerton, Chesley, Paisley, Neustadt
